decision_rule: At grant, run one bounded read-only aggregate census of the documented progress JSONL and checkpoint SQLite inputs; refuse missing progress inputs, incomplete or changing frontiers, database failures, and output collisions. Emit only aggregate counts, schema booleans, and custody metadata. No publication or HSF-3 completion claim; exact same-session completion-to-next-enqueue pairs meeting the two-window threshold remain required.
notes: Successor after r2 stopped at rc75 disk-floor before full census entry. Publisher smoke runs the same pinned aggregate-only census against live sources and writes only to isolated FILLER_DRYRUN_RESULT_PATH; full execution repeats against its then-current snapshot. No private rows emitted. Original decision rule and threshold retained.
